testcases.name: deepseek-ocr
testcases.l0_replacement_reason: DeepSeek-OCR scale stays nightly; deepseek-ocr-l0 keeps the OCR VL path with shorter decode for PR L0.
testcases.prompt: Extract the text from this image.
testcases.notes: The reference runs the official BF16 model.infer path in the family-owned Transformers 4.46.3 profile and preserves the original OCR prompt and required-substring contract. Decoder layers 6-11 and selector 12's embedding/final-logit boundary use FP32 to preserve that contract with TensorRT 11.2 while the remaining decoder path stays FP16.
